guidance.description: Ask the user 1-4 structured multiple-choice questions when a decision blocks progress. 2-4 options each; a free-text row is added automatically (never author "Other"). Recommended option first, label ending "(Recommended)". multiSelect when several apply; optional markdown preview per option (single-select only).
guidance.promptSnippet: Ask the user structured questions when requirements are ambiguous
promptGuidelines: Use ask_user_question only when you cannot proceed without the user's decision; group all questions into one call.
